decision: Quaternius Universal Base Characters + Universal Animation Library (CC0) as the assets
why: CC0 on source page and License.txt; one 65-joint skeleton shared by bodies, hair and 43 clips incl idle/walk/sit/crouch

decision: Bake texture detail into vertex colours; ship no textures
why: PNG textures are 1-4 MB each and KTX2 needs a toolchain; at 120 px vertex shade+garment mask is enough and recolours per person on CPU

decision: Move palette logic to lib/avatar.ts keeping the rng draw order
why: SVG must draw the same pixels (pnpm visual rome-1000bce-person) and 3D must agree with it

decision: Fixed anims.glb 2.7 MB -> 236 KiB: disposed samplers and their orphan keyframe accessors
why: gltf-transform dispose() of an Animation left samplers holding 3.8 MB of accessors that were still written

decision: Hair as one GLB per style instead of one merged file
why: a view loads only its own style (~25-65 KiB) and part 2 can add clothes the same way

decision: Kept Portrait's rng draw order inside portraitLooks; 3D-only draws (beard, phase) use a second seed
why: SVG must not move a pixel; 3D needs extra randomness without shifting the SVG's draws
evidence: evidence/portrait-same-svg.txt: old vs new Portrait innerHTML equal for 210 people x 3 records

decision: Child height from a linear growth fit 77+6.1*age cm vs 170 cm adult; head bone scale 1+0.6*(1-height)
why: close to WHO medians (86 cm at 2, 116 at 6, 150 at 12); bigger head reads as a child on an adult mesh
